title: Nari-Nari dialect
extract: Nari Nari is an extinct Indigenous Australian dialect of Wemba Wemba once spoken in New South Wales. The last person who could speak Nari Nari was Angus Myers, a Jitajita man. It was last recorded in 1967, but date of extinction is unknown.
